blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Choco Mucho vented its ire on winless Galeries Tower, 21-25, 25-17, 25-19, 25-15, to regain its winning ways in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Conference on Tuesday night at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Eya Laure and Sisi Rondina-Rosales provided spark for the Flying Titans after a lethargic start, as they took the solo third place with a 3-1 record behind unbeaten leaders Creamline Cool Smashers and Nxled Chameleons, who are tied at 3-0. Laure led the way with 18 points on top of 11 excellent receptions and nine digs, while Rosales sparked the bench with 11 points. Caitlin […]...
